The golden test is green locally now, and the fix was in the code, not the test.

**Cause:** `footprintArea` in `packages/geo-model3d/src/footprint-area.js` skipped the closing edge of the ring (last point back to first). For the 10 × 8 rectangle at an offset from the origin it returned 88 m² instead of 80.

**Fix:** the loop now covers every edge including the closing one. The test and its 80 m² expectation are untouched.

**Verified locally:** the golden suite (117 passed, 3 skipped — the val3dity ones), the unit suite (1327 passed), types and the architecture check all pass. I did not run the docs and backlog-sync checks from `npm run check`.

Nothing is committed or pushed yet, so CI is still red until the change goes up. Say the word and I'll commit and push it.
